name: Xiaobo Chen
headline: Reliable and secure LLM agents for software engineering.
bio: I study where LLM agents look correct but are not: code repairs that pass tests and still break behavior, and multi-agent handoffs that lose or corrupt user requirements. My studies are preregistered and use exactly scorable tasks, so each claim can be checked.

projects.name: AI4SE Atlas
projects.description: An open, curated, unranked directory of AI for Software Engineering researchers, topics, papers and open-source projects, with JSON, CSV and BibTeX data.

projects.name: AI Agent Papers
projects.description: A one-page list of my arXiv papers with summaries and BibTeX.

about: I have about ten years of experience in software engineering and AI research, including earlier work as a software engineer at Alibaba.
I received bachelor’s and graduate degrees in electrical engineering (Electronic Information Engineering; Signal and Information Processing) from Xidian University (西安电子科技大学), Xi’an, China.
I welcome research collaboration on reliable and secure LLM agents and AI for software engineering.
